fragment: Brand Kits lets you upload and organize your team or organization's official logos, colors, fonts, and assets in one place. Admins and brand designers can create multiple kits for different teams, clients, or campaigns.

Limits per team:
* Up to 1,000 Brand Kits, depending on your subscription.
* Up to 2,000 brand assets per asset category in a Brand Kit

Scale your design process and save time with Bulk Create. Instantly generate hundreds of design variations for large-scale projects, from localizing marketing campaigns and personalizing sales materials to creating custom business cards and event invitations.

How Bulk Create works

Before you start, it helps to understand the core way Bulk Create functions. It works by linking your data (organized in rows and columns) to placeholder elements on your design page.

You can select up to 300 rows and 150 columns only. Selections beyond this won't be accepted.
Upload data using Excel or CSV file
Before uploading a file, make sure that your file is in Comma Separated Value (CSV), and Microsoft Excel Spreadsheet (XLSX) formats.

Output: This controls whether you get one design file or many.
1 design with multiple pages: Choose this to create a single Canva design file. Each row of your data will become a new page within that one design.
Individual designs: Choose this to create a separate Canva design file for each row of your data. These individual designs will be automatically grouped into a new folder in your Projects.

A workspace is where your team creates, reviews, approves, and schedules content for a specific brand or client. It keeps everything for that brand in one place, including social media pages, campaigns, collaborators, and shared assets.

Workspaces let you separate clients and brands, keep collaboration private, and customize workflows so each client relationship runs the way you need.

Planable recommends one workspace per brand or client.

Planable is collaboration-first, so your team can create, review, and approve content in one place before anything goes live. That means fewer scattered files, fewer back-and-forth messages, and a clearer approval process.

Planable is designed for:
* Agencies managing multiple clients and approval cycles
* Brands coordinating internal teams plus external stakeholders (partners, legal, executives)

With Planable, you can:
* Handle multiple brands in dedicated workspaces
* Create and refine pieces with comments, annotations, and suggestions
* Approve content in your personalized workflow: from none required to multi-approval levels

Planable's pricing is per workspace, with unlimited users. It's not priced per seat.
